ارتضختما (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَخْتُمَا (irtaḍaḵtumā) /ir.ta.dˤax.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
# اُرْتُضِخْتُمَا (urtuḍiḵtumā) /ur.tu.dˤix.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِرْتَضَخَ (irtaḍaḵa)
